volume_step.label: Volume step size
volume_step.description:
How much the volume changes per step when using volume up/down commands, For example within the web interface by using the scroll wheel, tapping the ends of a volume slider or when using Home Assistant to issue a volume up or down command.

Leave at 0 to use the adaptive default, which takes smaller steps near the ends of the range.

announce_tts_engine.label: Announcement text-to-speech engine
announce_tts_engine.description: The engine used to speak an announcement that is sent as a text message instead of an audio link.

announce_tts_engine_unavailable.label: No text-to-speech engine is available. Set up a plugin that provides text-to-speech, for example the Home Assistant plugin with a TTS entity.
